notes: Found genuine site-defined Clearance structure. Discovery: homepage nav has a % 'Angebote & Werbung' menu containing a link to /c/online-lagerraeumungsverkauf (page <title>: 'XXXLutz Moebel Abverkauf - Lagerraeumungsverkauf - XXXLutz.de'; <h1>: 'Moebel-Abverkauf online'; og:description confirms 'Ueber 1100 Artikel'). This is a dedicated CMS landing page (distinct from the generic /c/moebel-angebote 'Moebel Angebote guenstig kaufen' promo page, which was checked and correctly excluded as a generic temporary-offers page per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule). The Abverkauf hub page itself aggregates only small teaser carousels per room/category (no single sitewide total, 'Nur online ausgestellt'/ONLINE ONLY badges on many items confirming permanent-markdown/limited floor-sample stock, not a seasonal campaign) and links out via 'Weitere X entdecken' to 22 category-specific listings, each the same underlying category filtered by the site's own p_eyecatcher=Abverkauf facet (a genuine, user-facing filter chip titled 'Abverkauf' inside the 'Angebote & Bestellbarkeit' facet group present on every category page - not a color/material/brand attribute re-cut). Every leaf's qty was pulled from the SSR GraphQL 'totalResults' field and verified via the exhaustion check ceil(totalResults/pageSize)==totalPages (pageSize=60 throughout); all 22 leaves passed. Parent row's own qty is null because the hub is an aggregation of overlapping-eligible category views with no single sitewide count field (summing children would double count nothing here since categories are disjoint, but the hub page itself never states one total, so left null per the exact-evidence rule rather than computed). Checked also: sitemap-categories.xml for raeumung/restposten/outlet/clearance keywords (no separate dedicated category nodes beyond the CMS hub); site search for clearance terms not separately run since the hub was found directly via nav.
